question: Do retained-library expression patterns show greater KO-HET divergence in CD62L-low than high, as in published Figure 6?
decision: Proceed to a direct descriptive interaction contrast if source QC supports interpretable state comparisons; revisit feature/sample QC if discrepancies dominate.
strongest_rival: Different bulk mixtures or selective survival within the Foxp3-positive gate, plus technical preparation variability, can mimic state-dependent regulation.
discriminator: Show retained-library PCA, four merged-estimate PCA and all four signed contrasts with explicitly separate feature universes. These diagnose source patterns but do not distinguish within-cell regulation from selection.
exposure_record: Published results, S0 qualification and source headers are exposed; S1 numerical expression contrasts and PCA have not yet been computed. Exposed reconstruction, not confirmation.
biological_unit: Source biological preparation; individual mouse, pool membership and cross-state pairing remain unknown. This stage counts files/features, not animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve libraries from one study; GSM1423627 excluded by authors. All reuse of these libraries is shared-source reanalysis. Replicate labels do not prove pairing or independence.
population_and_selection: Female C57BL/6 healthy mosaic mice; spleen/LN sorted Foxp3-positive CD4+CD25+YFP+RFP+ Tregs, conditional Ezh2 HET or KO, observed CD62L high/low.
contrast: Low-minus-high within HET and KO; KO-minus-HET within high and low. Group means are means of library log2(FPKM+1). Merged deposited estimates are a separate descriptive view.
endpoint: Signed log2(FPKM+1) expression contrasts; contrast RMS and median absolute magnitude; library and group-estimate PCA coordinates.
methods: Use S0 common features with OK status in all 11 retained libraries and FPKM>=1 in at least one library. log2(FPKM+1), mean transformed expression per group, gene-centered unscaled PCA by SVD. Merged PCA uses its own all-four-OK, finite nonnegative, any-group FPKM>=1 rows. No feature optimization, DEG tests, significance threshold or normalization beyond declared transform.
missingness_and_exclusions: Exclude source GSM1423627; omit non-OK common features and low-detection rows before analysis. Threshold 1 FPKM is a display eligibility rule, not an effect margin. No missing values imputed or confidence bounds interpreted as biological SEM.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or inferential gene family; all eligible loci and four contrasts retained.
precision_basis: Observed sample variation and PCA only; no confidence intervals because mouse/pool identity and independence are not qualified.
interpretation_limit: Adapted source reconstruction, not exact Figure 6 replay or independent replication. Selected CD62L states are not interventions/timepoints. FPKM contrasts cannot establish chromatin mechanism or functional fate.
stop_rule: Fail empty eligibility, nonfinite log/PCA or missing group. Strong sample/feature discrepancies trigger review before any downstream regulatory interpretation.
amendment_reason: Initial S1 specification selected prospectively from S0 qualified descriptive route. No inferred animal independence or count-model substitution.
